paragraphs: (It is a place-name.) Hyman mentions him in Demai, chapter 2, halakhah 2; R' Zeira sent to ask him.[^1]

notes.text: The complete Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Demai 2:2, seven paragraphs, was read without a matching Alexandri of Tzaduka notice. This bounded nonmatch does not establish absence elsewhere or a correction to Hyman’s locator. The place-name gloss and Zeira’s sending to ask are translated as Hyman’s report, with both abbreviated titles left R'; no residence, identity, or recipient is independently established from the nonmatch.
